2026-01-16 09:50:09+01:00 fix notification ID counter type mismatch in settings storage
Changed setLong to setInt for NOTIFICATION_ID_COUNTER (2 locations) to match corresponding getInt() calls. Prevents notification ID collisions and incorrect counter resets. Branches: fork_34066/eugentoptic44-fix-bugs-012026

2026-01-16 09:50:14+01:00 add null check to prevent crash on first app launch
Added null check after getCurrentWeatherInfo() in onCreate() to handle case where database is empty on initial app startup. Branches: fork_34066/eugentoptic44-fix-bugs-012026

2026-01-16 09:50:18+01:00 add warning fetch and notification trigger on device boot
Implemented warning fetch and notification display in onCreate() receiver to restore active warnings after device restart. Branches: fork_34066/eugentoptic44-fix-bugs-012026

2026-01-16 09:50:23+01:00 prioritize location freshness over accuracy in automatic selection
Changed location comparison from standalone if to else if with timestamp equality check. Ensures newest location is always selected; accuracy used only as tiebreaker for same-timestamp locations. Branches: fork_34066/eugentoptic44-fix-bugs-012026

2026-01-16 09:50:28+01:00 fix warning polygon overlay rendering with correct pixel coordinate
Changed warningPolygonY[3] from chartTimeStart (timestamp) to chartHeight (pixel coordinate). Prevents warning rectangles from extending off-screen. Branches: fork_34066/eugentoptic44-fix-bugs-012026

2026-01-16 09:50:33+01:00 fix data storage duplicate key and boolean value retrieval
- Changed DATASTORAGE_NC_CHANNEL_DETAIL from 15 to 16 to eliminate duplicate ID - Added static modifier to getBoolean() method - Fixed boolean logic: changed valueLong == 0 to valueLong != 0 for correct value interpretation Branches: fork_34066/eugentoptic44-fix-bugs-012026

2026-01-16 09:50:39+01:00 fix 24-hour forecast pressure field and enhance code documentation

2026-01-16 09:50:45+01:00 add null check for optional warning instruction field
Added defensive null check before accessing instruction field in getPlainTextWarning() to prevent crashes when warnings lack instruction text.
